people.name: Hamor
people.line: A Hivite prince, father of Shechem.

people.name: Shechem
people.line: Founded the city where Dinah was raped

translations.web: Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her. He took her, lay with her, and humbled her.
translations.bsb: When Shechem son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the region, saw her, he took her and lay with her by force.
translations.kjv: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.
translations.asv: And Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her; And he took her, and lay with her, and humbled her.
